source.authorityName: School examination paper (school not named); obtained from icseboard.org, originally from icseonline.com
source.notes: Scanned school paper (no text layer apart from the icseboard.org watermark). Printed header: Final Examination - 2017-2018, BIOLOGY, Std. : VIII, Time : 2 hrs. + 15 min., F. M. : 80 (durationMinutes 135 as printed). examYear 2018 is the later year of the printed session 2017-2018. Section A (40 Marks, all compulsory) is the first question, whose number is printed as 'I.' (recorded as '1'; later questions are printed 2.-6.), with sub-questions I-V; each sub-question carries one printed mark for its whole group, so each group is one entry. Section B (40 marks) says 'Attempt any four questions' of Questions 2-6 (10 marks each), so the pack total (90) exceeds the 80-mark maximum; no choiceGroup is set because the choice is 'any four of five'. Many topics (tissues, animal classification, microbes, health and waste management) have no matching chapter in the current taxonomy and are left with chapter null. No school name printed. No answer key.
source.usage: School examination paper published on icseboard.org (originally icseonline.com); question text reproduced for study with attribution and a link to where it was obtained. Figures are not reproduced.
